title: HeSum: a Novel Dataset for Abstractive Text Summarization in Hebrew
reasoning: The paper focuses on introducing and evaluating a Hebrew text summarization dataset (HeSum). Although it includes a section on 'Ethics' related to data sourcing and 'Limitations' regarding linguistic variability and potential news-style bias, and provides an error analysis that includes gender mismatch, these are standard components of NLP research and do not constitute an evaluation or benchmark of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
